name: Toraware no Twin Tail
original_name: 囚われのツインテール
source:
"---Um, um... Master, please hurry... I can't wait any longer..."
Rie, chained up, begs for more torture, as sweet nectar drips from her private parts.
There is no trace left of the fastidious Rie that once was. All that remains is the image of a female who has been perfected as a masochist...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227145/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“——那、那个……主人，请快一点……我、我已经忍不住了……”
被锁链拴住的理惠，私密处不断滴落甜美的蜜汁，苦苦哀求着新一轮的折磨。
她身上早已不见昔日那个有洁癖的理惠的影子，留下的只有被彻底调教成受虐狂的一介雌性姿态……

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227145/]Getchu[/url]]
